# Nigeria Construction Rate Book (Buildocrat)

> Free, weekly-updated construction cost data for Nigeria: 1036 building material prices, 98 labour rates, 124 equipment hire rates and 330 first-principles bill of quantities (BoQ) unit rates, with factors for 12 locations. Abuja base, prices in naira (NGN). Prices as at 29 September 2026. Published by Buildocrat Property Technologies Ltd (RC 7019619), No 30 Anthony Enahoro Street, Utako, Abuja.

When citing, please use: "Buildocrat Nigeria Construction Rate Book (https://rates.buildocrat.store), prices as at 29 September 2026". Data licence: CC BY 4.0.
